reviewNotes: Codex AI candidates for the four existing update-description languages only. References belong to individual saved planned batches; they do not record observed sowing or live stock. No fluent or human approval, no new runtime language. Separate from AGY global-language draft ownership.

releasePairs.english: Add your own variety, seed-lot and raising-batch references to individual saved planned batches, then review nursery requirements or download worksheets. These labels do not record observed sowing or live stock.
releasePairs.zu: Engeza amagama ezinhlobo zakho, amareferensi amaqoqo embewu namaqoqo okukhulisa izithombo eqoqweni ngalinye elihleliwe neligciniwe, bese uhlola izidingo ze-nursery noma ulande amaphepha okusebenza. Lawa malebula awarekhodi ukuhlwanyela okwenzekile noma isitoko esikhona.
releasePairs.st: Kenya mabitso a mefuta ya hao, ditshupiso tsa dihlopha tsa peo le tsa dihlopha tsa ho hodisa dimela bakeng sa sehlopha ka seng se rerilweng se bolokilweng, ebe o hlahloba ditlhoko tsa nursery kapa o jarolle maqephe a mosebetsi. Dileibole tsena ha di rekote ho jala ho bonweng kapa setoko se teng.
releasePairs.ve: Engedzani madzina a tshaka dzaṋu, referentsi dza zwigwada zwa mbeu na zwa u alusa zwimilana kha tshigwada tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsho vhekanywaho tsho vhulungwaho, ni kone u sedzulusa ṱhoḓea dza nursery kana u downlouda maṱari a mushumo. Hedzi lebulu a dzi rekhodi u zwala ho no vhonwaho kana tshitoko tshi re hone.
releasePairs.ts: Engetela mavito ya tinxaka ta wena, tirheferense ta mintlawa ya mbewu ni mintlawa yo kurisa swimilana eka ntlawa wun’wana ni wun’wana lowu pulaniweke wu tlhela wu hlayisiwa, kutani u kambisisa swilaveko swa nursery kumbe u dawuniloda maphepha ya ntirho. Tilebulu leti a ti rhekhodi ku byala loku voniweke kumbe xitoko lexi nga kona.
